Done. This question was correct, but it surfaced one genuinely useful disambiguation gap worth recording.

What I saved (patched into `currency-and-geomean.md`):
- A new "Geometric mean of RAW LEVELS" section. The existing geomean references were all about the *traps* — converting growth rates to factors, de-annualizing "annual rate" quarters, geomean-of-ratios. None covered the plainest case: when the question hands you raw level values (silver production, receipts, debt), you just take the direct N-th root of the product. No +1/-1, no de-annualization, no ratio step. The risk this prevents is a future agent over-thinking a simple-levels question and wrongly applying the factor-conversion machinery the rest of the file emphasizes.

No memory update needed — my MODE A delimiter rule and rounding conventions already covered the formatting side, and this was a textbook application of them.
